title: IELTS API: a free, no-authentication REST API and open dataset for IELTS preparation research
description: A free, open, no-authentication REST API for IELTS preparation research: Cambridge IELTS 1-22 vocabulary, 50 high-frequency themes, practice curriculum catalogue (1,852 units), 17 task family strategies, analytic band descriptors, score concordances, task banks and an indexed open research corpus.
